description: Source code for utility functions related to TR-069 protocol handling, including IPC initialization, parameter get/set, error handling, and command-line parsing.

methods.name: initilize
methods.description: Initializes IPC bus connection, retries until successful.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Returns textual description of error codes from host interface.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Retrieves parameter type via IARM bus call.

methods.name: convertParamValues
methods.description: Converts string values to appropriate parameter types.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts a character to a parameter type enumeration.

methods.name: printParameterDetails
methods.description: Prints details of a parameter based on its type.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value of a parameter via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets attribute value of a parameter via IARM bus call.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for get/set operations and options.

methods.name: trsetutil
methods.description: Main utility function to handle parameter get/set based on command-line input.
